description: Reply in a thread you participate in; appends with the next seq. Blocked or contact-closed participants are skipped and listed in refused rather than failing the reply. thread_not_found (byte-identical for a nonexistent id) if you are not a participant.

dedupe_key.description: Resend with the same key within 24h to get back the original message_id instead of a duplicate.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.msg.reply
